description: The USPS recommended send-by dates for delivery before December 25 for the current holiday season, read at call time from usps.com: Ground Advantage, First-Class Mail, Priority Mail and Priority Mail Express to the lower 48 and to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and territories; First-Class Package International, Priority Mail International and Priority Mail Express International by world region; and APO/FPO/DPO military mail by ZIP group. Includes days left from today.
name: get_usps_holiday_shipping_deadlines
title: Get USPS holiday shipping deadlines
